name: check_availability
purpose: Call to get free start times for a booking. Needs service_id (from get_services), branch_id (from get_branches), date as YYYY-MM-DD and number of guests. Ask the guest only for what is still missing. Call again whenever any of them changes.
outputMessage:
Free start times (local time, JSON) for service_id={{avail_service}}, branch_id={{avail_branch}}, date={{avail_date}}, guests={{avail_guests}}: {{avail_slots_json}}
- A list of times: group consecutive times into ranges (e.g. 9h–17h30), make clear they are start times, and ask which one suits the guest.
- []: there are no free slots for that choice; suggest another day or branch.
- ERP_UNAVAILABLE: you cannot check free times right now; offer staff. Never say there are no free slots in this case.
